title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
author: Lukas Knobel; Andrew Zisserman; Yuki M. Asano
summary: The paper presents a method called SDM that learns motion representations from frozen image features by predicting how these features change over time. SDM separates motion into primary and residual components, improving performance on various video benchmarks for camera and object motion. This approach outperforms baseline methods and competes with supervised models while requiring less supervision.
